scope: Actual translated Si primitive potential arrays only; no particles, waves, scan or CUDA execution

actual_original_CIF_crystal_proof.proof: Integer CIF lattice translations along all laboratory axes; exact tiled potential checked separately
actual_original_CIF_crystal_proof.basis_registration_scope: Measured periodic signed differences from original unrounded CIF sites; common numerical offset restored by the analytic builder, remaining per-site error charged

potential_error.scope: Potential storage, geometric registration and padded XY images; additional discretization is qualified by the unchanged scan comparisons
